checks.name: Two stale pages append independent analyses without overwriting either result
A stale unchanged record never resurrects an externally deleted experiment
Conflicting source contents, altered analysis history and same analysis IDs are refused
Independent record appends merge and replacement deletion retains strict optimistic protection
Race during write, silent storage refusal and unreadable archives preserve the disk
Reimporting full display samples merges analyses with the compact stored source
Conflicts at shared full-curve steps cannot hide behind display decimation
Repeated anonymous legacy attempts remain present rather than silently deduplicated
Malformed imported analysis views are rejected before they can break the archive interface
Earlier analyses and original curves remain selectable without changing the live solver
Selected historical analysis export retains its own result and original source identity
Original source selection hides computed results and disables analysis-only export
A chosen unsaved analysis stays selected after merging another page’s independent result
Quota failure preserves all session results and an explicit retry verifies recovery
Pending numerical execution refuses archive import and keeps the eventual result attached
An import whose file read began earlier is rechecked before it can replace an active execution source
Remote deletion during a pending job keeps its source and completed analysis in this session without resurrection

scope: Actual fixed-step source record, archive merges and conflict preservation, DOM selection/export/retry. Analysis numeric display values are declared fixtures; no new controller performance or browser GPU claim. Optimistic cross-page detection is not a transactional lock.
